ns2:section.sectionText: Introduction to neural network modeling, the principles of neural computation, learning algorithms and the evaluation of neural networks as models of human perception and cognition. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. **Elective course for Cognitive or Intradisciplinary Concentration; Research Methods/Lab for Intradisciplinary**
